hypothesis: A provenance-bound typed freeze receipt with deterministic split-bound roots, hard cross-split alias rejection, protected-payload exclusion and an independent semantic-contamination review gate can provide a reproducible final-data substrate without claiming universal decontamination.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Exact hashes, NFC and lexical/format projections cannot establish semantic cleanliness against paraphrase, translation or other meaning-preserving contamination; therefore semantic review must remain independently blocking.

fresh_external_evidence.source: Google Research deduplicate-text-datasets / Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
fresh_external_evidence.delta: Exact/near-duplicate controls are useful for contamination and memorization reduction.

fresh_external_evidence.source: ACL 2024 Data Contamination Can Cross Language Barriers
fresh_external_evidence.delta: Cross-language contamination can evade superficial overlap checks.

fresh_external_evidence.source: arXiv Rethinking Benchmark and Contamination for Language Models with Rephrased Samples
fresh_external_evidence.delta: String/n-gram checks are insufficient against rephrased contamination.
Invisible/default-ignorable format controls require comparison-aware handling; detection normalization must not silently replace source training text.
